topic_profiles.summary_ja: 半導体・先端実装は、演算器単体の性能ではなく、プロセス、チップレット分割、接合、メモリ、熱、歩留まり、供給能力を一体で判断する。MN-Coreは日本発の設計・開発として追跡しつつ、製造・供給網とHPCI向けソフトウェア適合性を別に評価する。
topic_profiles.summary_en: Semiconductor and advanced-integration choices must be evaluated across process, chiplet partitioning, bonding, memory, thermals, yield, and supply rather than compute performance alone. MN-Core is tracked as Japan-originated design and development while manufacturing, supply, and HPCI software fit remain separate questions.

sections.summary_en: TSVs, D2W, W2W, and hybrid bonding are not only alternatives; they can be combined according to product constraints.

topic_profiles.summary_ja: メモリ階層とデータ移動は、主記憶、容量拡張、3D実装、scale-up/scale-out接続、PIMを一体で扱う。現在利用できる製品、近い将来の標準・製品候補、研究段階、競合中の方式を区別し、HPCIアプリの帯域・遅延・容量・通信特性へ対応付ける。
topic_profiles.summary_en: Memory hierarchy and data movement are treated across main memory, capacity expansion, 3D integration, scale-up and scale-out fabrics, and PIM. Shipping products, near-term standards or products, research concepts, and competing approaches are separated and mapped to HPCI workload bandwidth, latency, capacity, and communication behavior.

sections.title_ja: 主記憶
sections.summary_ja: CPU主記憶の容量・保守性と、アクセラレータ近傍メモリの帯域を役割分担する。
sections.summary_en: Balance CPU-main-memory capacity and serviceability with near-accelerator bandwidth.

items.statement_ja: DDR5はCPU直結主記憶の中心で、RDIMM、MRDIMM、3DS RDIMMにより帯域と容量が拡張されている。
items.statement_en: DDR5 is the primary CPU-attached memory, with RDIMM, MRDIMM, and 3DS RDIMM extending bandwidth and capacity.
items.hpci_relevance_ja: 容量単価、交換性、CPU channel数に優れる一方、HBMより帯域が低く、memory-bound workloadでは役割分担が必要。
items.hpci_relevance_en: It offers capacity economics and serviceability but less bandwidth than HBM, requiring explicit role division for memory-bound workloads.
adoption_conditions_ja: 実効帯域・遅延
容量単価
CPU世代との整合

items.statement_ja: HBM4はSamsung、SK hynix、Micronが量産・出荷を公表し、AI/HPC accelerator近傍の高帯域メモリとして導入が始まっている。
items.statement_en: Samsung, SK hynix, and Micron have announced HBM4 production or shipment, beginning commercial adoption as near-accelerator high-bandwidth memory.
items.hpci_relevance_ja: GPU・accelerator選択と不可分で、ピーク帯域だけでなく容量、熱、供給配分、交換不能性が重要。
items.hpci_relevance_en: It is inseparable from GPU or accelerator selection; capacity, thermals, supply allocation, and limited serviceability matter alongside peak bandwidth.
adoption_conditions_ja: 熱的に持続可能な帯域
容量と歩留まり
複数年供給

items.timing_en: SOCAMM2 entered production in 2026; LPDDR6 is in standard and product introduction
items.statement_ja: 低消費電力LPDDRを高密度server memoryへ展開する動きが進み、SOCAMM2量産とLPDDR6標準化が確認できる。
items.statement_en: Low-power LPDDR is moving into dense server memory, with SOCAMM2 production and LPDDR6 standardization confirmed.
items.hpci_relevance_ja: 電力・容量密度に利点がある一方、ECC/RAS、platform依存、交換性、長期供給をRDIMMと比較する必要がある。
items.hpci_relevance_en: Power and capacity density may improve, but ECC/RAS, platform dependence, serviceability, and long-term supply must be compared with RDIMM.

標準化と相互運用
field交換性

sections.summary_ja: 容量を増やすことと、実アプリ性能が向上することを分けて評価する。
sections.summary_en: Separate capacity expansion from demonstrated application benefit.

items.statement_en: CXL 2.0 memory modules are commercial and can support CPU-memory expansion or tiering.

items.hpci_relevance_en: They may relieve capacity constraints, but NUMA latency, migration, page placement, and scheduler integration require measurement.

OS・scheduler統合

items.statement_en: CXL 4.0 is published, but public products and demonstrations remain concentrated on 2.0 through 3.x, leaving a standards-to-product lag.
items.hpci_relevance_ja: poolingでは公平性、輻輳、admission control、switch障害を含む運用評価が必要。

items.statement_en: Capacity aggregation alone does not establish value; application comparisons covering interference, fairness, migration cost, and utilization remain insufficient.

sections.summary_ja: 接合方式、垂直配線、memory productを同じ成熟度として扱わない。

items.statement_ja: TSVはHBMや3DS DRAMの積層dieを接続する量産基盤技術であり、接合方式そのものではない。
items.statement_en: TSV is a production foundation for connecting stacked dies in HBM and 3DS DRAM; it is not itself a bonding method.
items.hpci_relevance_ja: 積層数、pitch、熱抵抗、反り、microbumpやhybrid bondingとの組合せをpackage単位で評価する。
items.hpci_relevance_en: Evaluate stack height, pitch, thermal resistance, warpage, and combination with microbumps or hybrid bonding at package level.

items.statement_en: D2W can integrate selected heterogeneous dies and enable dense logic, cache, I/O, and memory connectivity.
items.hpci_relevance_ja: memory bandwidth向上だけでなく、known-good-die、熱、供給者依存を確認する。
items.hpci_relevance_en: Assess known-good-die handling, thermals, and supplier dependence in addition to bandwidth.

items.statement_ja: MPI 5.0は標準ABIを導入済み。MPICH 5.0.0はMPI-5と新ABIの完全対応を公称する一方、MPI Forumの2026年Q3実装状況はMPICHを部分対応（FortranはMPICH ABIのみ）、Open MPIを未記載とし、MPICH側も2026年4月にmpifort_abi未提供を確認した。したがって、実装のリリース番号や包括的な対応表明だけでは、言語別・実装間の交換性を判断できない。
items.statement_en: MPI 5.0 introduced a standard ABI. Release numbers and broad conformance statements therefore do not establish language-specific cross-implementation interchangeability.

Public equations, coefficients, individual runtimes, and independent validation errors are not provided. OpenFS therefore publishes a low-confidence analytical forecast from public design assumptions.

Public equations, coefficients, individual runtimes, and independent validation errors are not provided. OpenFS therefore publishes a low-confidence analytical forecast from public design assumptions.
